Every statement on this site carries tags rather than a home directory: an area, a model, a form and an assumption class. The pages below are generated views over those tags, so a statement appears under each tag it carries and nothing lives in any of them. For the full sortable index of everything, see [All statements](/problems/all/index.qmd).

- [All statements](all/index.qmd) -- the full sortable index.
